verdict: Paid channels (Meta and Google Ads) generated zero spend, leads, or clicks over the past 28 days, suggesting campaigns are paused or inactive. performance.verdict: No paid activity live; 5 overdue milestones block every revenue signal.

findings.text: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, and Site/Landing Pages were all due 2026-07-31 — now 29 days overdue with no completion signal.
Ads Launch (LSA + Search) and Meta Retargeting were due 2026-08-01 — 28 days overdue; $0 spend across all 28 days confirms neither went live.
Spend efficiency is unmeasurable: $0 spend, 0 leads, and 0 CPL for all 28 days — no paid channel has ever been active in the data window.
GBP actions collapsed to 0 for the last 3 days (Aug 26–28) vs an average of ~3.4/day over the prior 25 days — a confirmed 3-day signal, not noise.
GHL shows 111 contacts and 14 opportunities created but 0 appointments and 0 won — intake routing or calendar booking is not functioning.

suggestions.text: Clear all 5 overdue SOW blockers immediately; no paid budget should move until stack test passes and pixels are verified.
suggestions.monday_update: Five milestones are confirmed overdue by 28–29 days: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages (due Jul 31), and both Ads Launch and Meta Retargeting (due Aug 1). Zero spend and zero leads across the entire 28-day window confirm no campaigns have ever gone live. Success check: stack test signed off, LSA verification submitted, and site confirmed live by 2026-09-05. No paid budget activates before these are cleared.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL appointment booking: 14 opportunities created but 0 appointments booked signals a broken calendar or routing step.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 14 opportunities created against 0 appointments in the 28-day window — the calendar or booking link in the intake flow is not functioning. Nacer should test the end-to-end booking flow from a new contact through to a confirmed appointment. Success check: at least 1 test appointment books and appears in GHL within 24 hours of the fix, confirmed by 2026-09-01.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP: 0 actions for 3 consecutive days (Aug 26–28); check for listing suspension or ranking drop before ads launch.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped to 0 for Aug 26, 27, and 28 — the first 3-day zero streak in the 45-day series after averaging ~3.4 actions/day. This may indicate a listing suspension, ranking shift, or weekend effect. Monitor the listing status in Google Business Profile dashboard and check for any policy flags. Re-check on 2026-09-01: if actions remain at 0, escalate to a listing audit before paid traffic is sent to the GBP profile.
